September 9, 2026

![Three people hold up a poster that shows diagrams, arrows, and doodles](data:image/png;base64,)![Three people hold up a poster that shows diagrams, arrows, and doodles](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/2b23b13511ee20564487780c33a3829f00f262c4-760x428.png?w=1632&h=919&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

True collaboration isn’t always comfortable.

Illustrations by Hannah Schrage

You have to be willing to share the messy parts of the process—the rough sketches, the unresolved questions—so others can build on those ideas. In that spirit, we’re taking you behind the scenes at Figma to share the human side of building with AI.

[![Caterpillar holding an envelope](data:image/png;base64,)![Caterpillar holding an envelope](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/3794b1a87bcbbf86ff0eb82b17b7bab4afb57cb2-2160x1216.png?w=2160&h=1216&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/blog/newsletter/)

Want the next issue delivered straight to your inbox? [Sign up here](https://www.figma.com/blog/newsletter/).

![Collage showing Config sculptures, abstract shapes, and an illustrated hibiscus flower](data:image/png;base64,)![Collage showing Config sculptures, abstract shapes, and an illustrated hibiscus flower](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/6598fdc25e9fd87162cbaa5e35818cbad02a9033-1296x726.png?rect=0,1,1296,725&w=804&h=450&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

1\. Digital tools make it easy to produce something slick—but for Config 2026, our Brand Studio used Figma Make to help create [**a visual language that was perfectly imperfect**](https://www.figma.com/blog/the-visual-identity-behind-config-2026/)

.

2\. We’ve all heard how AI is shifting responsibilities, but what does that actually look like? An engineer, designer, and product manager share [**how building nested folders in Figma gave them a new outlook on their roles**](https://www.figma.com/blog/code-craft-and-the-making-of-nested-folders/)

.

3\. Product Designer Rogie King was on a mission to bring shaders to Figma—but first, he had to assemble the right team. Here’s what it took to ship generative tools: an airtight pitch, a prototype-first process, and [**a passion that was contagious**](https://www.figma.com/blog/how-we-built-generative-plugins-and-shaders/)

.

4\. We built the AI sentiment index to measure how the industry is changing, how we feel about it, and what it means for the future of design. Researcher Shane Johnston breaks down [**how AI helped make sense of a huge amount of data**](https://www.figma.com/blog/measuring-the-impact-of-ai/)

.
